summary: CICS online Delete User screen (admin function). Retrieves a user security record by user id, displays it for confirmation, and on confirmation deletes the user record. Pseudo-conversational.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the delete-user screen (or the user passed in from the list). On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return to admin menu; Enter fetch and display the user; PF5 confirm delete. Return to CICS.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Require and validate the user id, then read the user record and display it. On the confirm action, delete the user security record; if the user id is not found, report it.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: a user is deleted only after the id is confirmed to exist and the admin confirms the deletion.

paragraphs.name: READ-USER-SEC-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the user security record by user id; on not-found set an error.

paragraphs.name: DELETE-USER-SEC-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Delete the user security record (CICS DELETE); on error report it.

paragraphs.name: SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and the user values and send the delete-user map.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-USRDEL-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the delete-user map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return to the admin menu / user list.
